prompt: Create an original 180 second cool jazz instrumental composition for mystery, nocturnal exploration and restrained suspense. Mood: mysterious, tense, nocturnal. Instruments: muted trumpet, vibraphone, double bass, brushes. Style: spare melodic answers, extended chords and unhurried swing. Tempo approximately 72 BPM; G minor. Main idea: an ascending fourth answered by a stepwise descent. Use unresolved suspended harmony, careful space and subtle low-register movement; no jump scares. Instrumental only. No vocals, no choir, no humming, no singing, no speech, no lyrics, no vocal samples. Do not imitate any existing artist or melody. [00:00-01:00] Establish the main idea immediately with the core ensemble. [01:00-02:00] Develop the motif with a complementary instrumental counterline, preserving the intended energy. [02:00-03:00] Return to the main idea and give a musically resolved ending with a short natural tail. Finish around 03:00.

description.en: A smooth and relaxed jazz piece featuring a prominent saxophone melody, supported by a classic jazz trio of piano, upright bass, and brushed drums.
description.zh: 一首流畅轻松的爵士乐曲，以萨克斯风为主旋律，配以钢琴、低音提琴和刷子鼓的经典爵士三重奏。
